676.d: Amberfell is a small village on Havenhythe, situated on the edge of the moorlands and built around ancient ruins, with maple trees throughout.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
• Fairy ring code DLP
• Home teleport to Wendlewick Alt+W, then take a canoe 4
• Travel to the Moonrise digsite, then head south
• Stonevein amulet Tree and go west.

gt.heading: Access
gt.text:
The bridge to Amberfell is initially out of commission, having fallen apart during flooding the previous season. A ranger stationed near the bridge warns that several travellers who headed east recently never returned. The trading caravans to Wendlewick have also not arrived for some time, as noted by Candle-maker Zeeva in Wendlewick who is originally from Amberfell.

Amberfell can be accessed after repairing the bridge south of Hollow Hill during the Secrets of Amberfell quest. After the village is visited for the first time, it can also be accessed via the fairy ring code DLP. Further, after repairing the canoe station with 6 maple planks and 20 steel nails, it can be accessed from any other station. [Chat: 4 Amberfell]

718.d: Anachronia, also known as Fossil Island or The Land Out of Time, is a prehistoric-style jungle island located north-east of Daemonheim.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text: Travelling to Anachronia for the first time requires the player to use The Stormbreaker, the ship built during the Breaking the Storm event, which is located east of the Varrock Dig Site (). Players can board the ship, located on the river, to visit Anachronia. Players will be shown a cutscene the first time they travel to the island and will have to guide a group of NPCs, including an archaeologist, Laniakea, and two guards, through the island.

gt.heading: Travel
gt.text:
Agility course

The primary means of travel across the island is traversing the Anachronia Agility Course. This requires Agility levels 30 to 85 to traverse. The course is divided into seven sections of varying difficulty but requires level 85 Agility to complete the whole lap.

Teleports

Quick methods to teleport across the island are ():
• Anachronia lodestone, which can be unlocked using materials after completing a tutorial with Giles at the base camp
• Slayer cape to teleport to Laniakea's at the south-east ruins
• North-western Anachronia Teleport spell to teleport to the north-western side of Anachronia, near the time altar
• Eastern Anachronia Teleport spell to teleport to the eastern side of Anachronia, a short distance to the east of the spirit grove
• Anachronia Teleport spell if a Totem of the Abyss is planted and active
• Anachronia tablet to teleport to the Player Lodge; it requires the Love Story quest and a tier 2 Player Lodge
• Ancient seed to Herby Werby
• Mystical tree in two steps: Manor Farm to Anachronia Dinosaur Farm (or Anachronia Dinosaur Farm teleport) and then run south-east; use a tree again to reach the west coast of Anachronia
• Dig sites map, master archaeologist's outfit or Archaeology teleport to Orthen Dig Site (or to Sharrigan) with 90 Archaeology
• Archaeology journal then run east to the Stormbreaker ship

Orthen teleportation device

Players with at least level 90 Archaeology can unlock the Orthen Dig Site and activate the Orthen teleportation devices, allowing them to teleport to four locations across the island:
• Crypt of Varanus, located near the arcane apoterrasaur hunting area
• Observation outpost, located north of the pavosaurus rex hunting area
• Moksha ritual site, located just east of the scimitops hunting area
• Xolo city, located within the Anachronia Swamp Fortress on the south-eastern tip of the island

730.d: Anachronia canyon mine, also known as north-east Anachronia mine, is a mine containing orichalcite and drakolith rocks in the north-east of Anachronia.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
• Teleport to observation outpost via Orthen teleportation device, then run towards north-west and then the mine through brutish dinosaurs.
• Teleport to the Anachronia lodestone, exit the north end of the Anachronia base camp and run north-east.
• Have the Totem of the Abyss active on the northern totem spot and then run south-east.
• Take the Anachronia Agility Course northbound (clockwise) and exit it near the feral dinosaurs and then run east. 
• Teleport to Herby Werby using an ancient seed, then run a short distance north-east.
• Teleport to Rex Matriarchs via Grouping System then run north.

g.how: {{Map}} on wiki page 'Anachronia canyon mine'

731.d: The Anachronia Dinosaur Farm, also known as the Ranch Out of Time (ROoT), is an expansion to player-owned farm located on an island off the west coast of Anachronia.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
All methods require having visited Anachronia at least once to use them. The most direct methods include:
• Grace of the elves teleport attuned via a Max Guild skill portal (after purchasing the Max guild portal attunement from the Anachronia Farmers' Market).
• Anachronia Dinosaur Farm teleport to Prehistoric Potterington after completing Extinction and then purchasing it with beans.
• Mystical tree on the top floor of the manor at Manor Farm.
• Mystical tree on the west coast of Anachronia next to the campfire (where the broken compass can be found).

735.d: Anachronia south-west mine is a mine located in the south-west of Anachronia.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
• Teleport to the Anachronia lodestone and run south-west.
• Have the Totem of the Abyss active on the western totem spot and then run south-east.
• Teleport to the Anachronia Dinosaur Farm either through an attuned grace of the elves necklace or by taking the Ardougne lodestone and going upstairs in the manor farm and using the mystical tree, then use the mystical tree south of the farm and travel to Anachronia and the rocks are a short run south-east.

736.d: The Anachronia Swamp Fortress is a mysterious fortress ruin, located in the south-east of Anachronia, where Laniakea can be found.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
• After completing the Teleport Node On mystery, the Orthen teleportation device at the entrance of the fortress can be reached from any of the other devices across Anachronia, such as the one at the base camp.
• Using the Slayer cape or the Slayer master cape, the player can teleport to Laniakea and arrive in the middle of the fortress.
• After completion of the Raksha the Shadow Colossus quest players can use the combat portal or a boss portal to teleport to Raksha within the Orthen Oubliette, and exit out to the swamp fortress.

g.how: {{Map}} on wiki page 'Anachronia Swamp Fortress'

737.d: Anachronia Swamp mine, also known as south-east Anachronia mine, is a mine located in the south-east of Anachronia.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
• With the Teleport Node On mystery complete, teleport to the Anachronia base camp, use the Orthen teleportation device to teleport to Xolo City, then run north-west.
• Using a Slayer cape or any of its variants to teleport to Laniakea and run north-west.
• If the Boss portal (Max Guild) or Boss portal (War's Retreat) is attuned to Raksha, then use it, exit the building and run north-west.
• Take the Anachronia Agility Course southbound (counter clock wise) and exit it near the yellow salamanders and then run east.
• Have the Totem of the Abyss active on the south-eastern totem spot and then run south-west.
• Teleport to the Anachronia lodestone, exit the base camp to the west of the lodestone, and then run to the south-eastern part of the island.
